feeds.title: Wealthy Single Mommy » Dating
feeds.description: This section of the blog features advice, tips, and stories about dating as a single mom. Authored by Emma Johnson. She is a business journalist, gender equality activist, author of The Kickass Single Mom (Penguin), and founder of Wealthysinglemommy.com, the world's largest platform for single moms.
